question_record.context: In our investigation of a suspicious system hardware discovery incident which involved activities likely aimed at gathering information about the target device or network, we noted the presence of several significant processes executed on the host `mb-winclient`. For example, the process `svchost.exe` with command line `2880__2024-07-02t07:28:40.7133644z__svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s winmgmt` and another process involving a PowerShell script `contosoadfsblatempcreds.ps1` were identified.
question_record.question: During our investigation, we observed an attempt to hide the use of a dual-purpose tool under an unexpected filename. This was associated with an account. Can you identify the name of the account related to this suspicious attempt?
solution: There is a suspicious system hardware discovery performed using `powershell.exe`.

A suspicious sequence of exploration activities was performed with Process ID `3116` at `2024-07-02T09:48:23.9439954Z` using the command line `iy2orr1e.rrg.exe` -windowstyle hidden -encodedcommand qwa6afwauwbjahiaaqbwahqacwbcaeuaeabwag8acgb0aeearabgafmavabvagsazqbuafmaaqbnag4aaqbuaemazqbyahqalgbwahmamqa=.
An attempt to hide the use of a dual-purpose tool was detected under an account named `gsmith`.

0.name: Suspicious System Hardware Discovery
0.description: A known tool or technique was used to gather information on this device. Attackers might be trying to gather information about the target device or network for later attacks.

52.name: Suspicious sequence of exploration activities
52.description: A process called a set of windows commands. These commands can be used by attackers in order to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine.

32.name: Attempt to hide use of dual-purpose tool
32.description:
A known public tool, which could also be used for malicious reasons, was observed under an unexpected filename.
This might be an attempt to hide the usage of that tool for malicious purposes.
